My household got the FISP coupons this season, so I will put one bag of NPK and one bag of urea on this maize plot. I will plant the hybrid seed they gave us because that is what my neighbors are using and last year their maize looked strong. I have no money for pesticides or to pay workers, so my sisters and I will do all the weeding and harvesting ourselves. This land is rented, so I will not waste time hauling manure here when I could be weeding.
